lessons: The premarket L2 spread cap is the dominant filter of this strategy as currently run, and it is not free: across Days 6 and 7 it has blocked the eventual best-performing halal name twice (KOPN +29%, SMWB +25%). A 0.5% cap on premarket books behaves very differently from the same cap after 09:30. Candidate backtest: depth-aware relaxation pre-09:30, or defer wide-book names to the open instead of rejecting them.

Coil and book quality are anti-correlated in the premarket. All morning the name with the coil and trusted pressure had the broken book, and the name with the tight book had lost its coil. Likely structural, and it means the ranking and the execution filter routinely disagree.

A single non-resolving position is the worst case for C37's economics: not a loss, a lockout. One trade that neither stops nor trails consumes all seven ticket slots' worth of session time for one ticket's worth of exposure. The edge lives in the rotation.

The fill-arming rule now has four data points and they are unambiguous: both negative fill-realism observations came from arming at an already-printed level, both non-negatives from clean forward triggers. Today's 3-cent ratchet self-correction is the cheapest possible demonstration.

Delegated sub-agents must carry hard exclusion lists. A delegated scan re-surfaced two names that had already FAILED a live screen this session because the universe file has no verdict for them. Caught both times; the prompt fix is in place.
